L&S: fidibus canere praeclārē, after Cic. Tusc. 1.4

canō, canere, cecinī + abl.

verb, third conjugation, with the ablative

Examples

  • Tympanum pulsā; ego tībiā canam.

    You bang the drum; I’ll play the pipe.composed

Other words

  • modulārī

    also used · classical · M-O s.v. play (a musical instrument)

  • harpā lūdere — play the harp

    avoid · modern · Traupman 326

    Follows the English “play”; Latin uses canere.

See also musical instrument, music, drum, flute, trumpet.
